title: Qwen3-235B-A22B UD-Q2_K_XL GGUF on llama.cpp: 128GB unified memory
slug_note: The only single-machine resident lane: unsloth's ~2-bit dynamic GGUF at 88GB on a 128GB Mac or Spark.

variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of unsloth/Qwen3-235B-A22B-GGUF resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-27 test

engine.config: llama-server with all layers offloaded; context capped so KV fits the ~40GB left after weights

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): 85.0 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772), --ctx-size 8192). Earlier estimate: 88GB weights + KV at 8-16K context; growing the context pushes a 128GB box into swap.

steps.text: brew install llama.cpp (or build with Metal/CUDA)

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (628-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler, long prompt (4658-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; write an LRU cache module with tests (35-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; write a 400-word essay (29-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; time to first streamed token on a cold 4658-token prompt
drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772), --ctx-size 8192

caveats: The model exceeds the RAM of every machine in this directory at BF16 (470GB) and at any quant above ~2 bits; it only runs locally via heavy quantization, SSD expert streaming, or a multi-GPU split.
No sourced speed number exists for this lane, so the row stays untested.
Quality loss at ~2 bits per weight on a 235B MoE is not characterized in our sources.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): `llama-server -hf unsloth/Qwen3-235B-A22B-GGUF:UD-Q2_K_XL --ctx-size 8192 -ngl 99` — llama.cpp build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772); server ready 80 s after start with the OS file cache dropped; the functional check passed; MemAvailable dropped 85.0 GiB (weights + KV at --ctx-size 8192).
